message: `{name}` is not a recognized access function
description: Access functions (`V`, `I`, `Temp`, `Pwr`, ...) are defined by the natures of the disciplines in scope. `{name}` is not one of them, often because the header declaring its nature was not included.
actions: Check the spelling against the natures in `disciplines.vams`.
`` `include "disciplines.vams" `` (or the header that declares the nature) before the module.
